title: The leak_scan extension point still declares file_hits without the root parameter that kbpublic now passes
goal: kbext's leak_scan point declares file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None) and its sample takes the root, matching kbpublic.file_hits

run: import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic;t=open('_tools/kbext.py').read();p=list(inspect.signature(kbpublic.file_hits).parameters);assert 'root' not in p or 'root' in t[t.find('leak_scan'):t.find('leak_scan')+800],'kbext leak_scan point declares no root while file_hits takes %s'%p

repro_reason: nothing wires the extension point yet, so the declared signature can only be compared with the function's
notes: Review note (S4) of SP-n7zxspch. kbext.py:130 declares file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=()); BG-r57wg5tg added root=None, and kbpublic passes it positionally at :644, :713 and :762. Nothing wires the point yet.
